files.label-printers.md:
# Label printers

From sources/options.md, prices as of 1 March 2026.

| Option | Price | Works with Mac |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Brightlabel P4 | $329 | Yes |
| Torrent T-200 | $279 | No |
| Kestrel LX | $459 | Yes |

## Recommendation

Buy the Brightlabel P4.

- It prints 100 by 150 mm courier labels.
- It works with the Mac on the packing bench.
- It is inside the $400 set aside.

The Torrent is cheaper but is Windows only. The Kestrel adds wifi and costs more than the budget.

files.thoughts.md:
Honestly it's a no-brainer! The first one is best-in-class and a game-changer, we can't go wrong. It costs $9,999 or so and I'd organize the rollout around it. Budget impact: 95%. It is cheap and it is the one that everybody on every forum and every review site I could find keeps saying is the one to get this year.
